thread:
alyssa: ok team, planning a compact release train for Wed May 8. We have 4 services: inference-api, routing, console, telemetry. Goal: finish by 11:00 PST. Proposed slots: S1 07:00-07:40, S2 07:40-08:20, S3 08:20-09:00, S4 09:00-10:00. Reply with: service | slot | wave-lead | smoke-owner | rollback-ready (y/n)

ben-ops: inference-api | S1 | @ben-ops | @sam-oncall | y

sam-oncall: I'll run smoke for inference-api. Please tag me 20m before S1. I'll post the smoke run link and a short output summary.

carmen: console | S3 | @carmen | @carmen | y

carmen: I'll coordinate canary at 25% traffic for 15m then greenlight to 100%.

lee: routing | S2 | @lee | @lee | partial

lee: rollback is prepared but we need to clear the route cache which takes ~15m; I'll schedule a cache-clear 30m before S2.

mira-eng: telemetry | S4 | @mira-eng | @sam-oncall | y

mira-eng: telemetry deploy depends on a schema migration that is backward compatible, but rollback needs a small DB step manual note. I'll add it to the PR.

alyssa: quick operational notes:
- Add the explicit rollback command to each PR description and paste in this thread.
- Smoke owners: include the CI smoke job link and the primary logs to check (errors, 5xx, latency p99).
- Wave leads: set a 5m pre-deploy check call in the calendar invite.

sam-oncall: smoke checklist snippet I use:```
# smoke minimal
curl -fsS https://inference-api.internal/health || exit 1
make -C infra smoke || exit 1
# check logs for new 5xx or spikes
```
I'll add this to the smoke CI and publish the run URL in-thread.

deploy-bot: INFO: infra reserved Wed May 8 07:00-10:00 PST. Autoscaler limited; canary routing configured for console.

ben-ops: PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/1301 - rollback: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/inference-api -n prod` plus note about feature-flag toggle.

mira-eng: PR: https://github.com/redwood/telemetry/pull/452 - rollback: `psql -c "SELECT set_config('app.telemetry_migration','rollback',true)"` (ops will run DB step).

lee: I'll create the calendar pre-warm for routing and mark 30m before S2.

carmen: will post canary status here; plan is 25% for 10m then 100% if metrics look good.

alyssa: final ask: please confirm your slots by EOD PST today. If anyone needs to swap, propose alternative slot and owner. I'll lock the release train tomorrow AM.

sam-oncall: confirmed S1, reachable during S1-S2. :thumbsup:
lee: confirmed S2, will handle pre-warm and cache clear.
carmen: confirmed S3, will post canary pass.
ben-ops: confirmed S1 and rollback in PR.
mira-eng: confirmed S4, added DB rollback note.

alyssa: locking slots now and updating tracker & calendar. I'll ping 24h before with the final checklist.
